imo-1965-q1.summary: Determine every $x$ with $0\le x\le2\pi$ for which $2\cos x\le\left|\sqrt{1+\sin2x}-\sqrt{1-\sin2x}\right|\le\sqrt2$.
imo-1965-q1.summaryZh: 求所有满足 $0\le x\le2\pi$ 且 $2\cos x\le\left|\sqrt{1+\sin2x}-\sqrt{1-\sin2x}\right|\le\sqrt2$ 的 $x$。

methods.title: Square the radical expression and separate the sign cases
methods.titleZh: 平方化简根式并按余弦符号分类
steps: Put $D=|\sqrt{1+\sin2x}-\sqrt{1-\sin2x}|$. Both radicals are defined, and $D^2=2-2\sqrt{1-\sin^22x}=2-2|\cos2x|$. Hence $0\le D\le\sqrt2$, so the upper bound is automatic.
If the two-sided inequality holds, then $2\cos x\le\sqrt2$, so $\cos x\le1/\sqrt2$. On $[0,2\pi]$ this is exactly $x\in[\pi/4,7\pi/4]$.

Conversely, take $x$ in that interval. If $\cos x\le0$, then $2\cos x\le0\le D$. If $\cos x>0$, then $\cos x\le1/\sqrt2$, so $\cos2x\le0$ and $D^2=2+2\cos2x=4\cos^2x$. Thus $D=2\cos x$. The lower bound holds in both cases, completing the equivalence.
stepsZh: 记 $D=|\sqrt{1+\sin2x}-\sqrt{1-\sin2x}|$。两个根式始终有定义，并且 $D^2=2-2\sqrt{1-\sin^22x}=2-2|\cos2x|$。因此 $0\le D\le\sqrt2$，右侧不等式恒成立。
若原不等式成立，则 $2\cos x\le\sqrt2$，即 $\cos x\le1/\sqrt2$。在 $[0,2\pi]$ 上，这恰好等价于 $x\in[\pi/4,7\pi/4]$。
反过来，取此区间内的 $x$。若 $\cos x\le0$，则 $2\cos x\le0\le D$。若 $\cos x>0$，则 $\cos x\le1/\sqrt2$，故 $\cos2x\le0$，从而 $D^2=2+2\cos2x=4\cos^2x$，即 $D=2\cos x$。两种情形都满足左侧不等式。

imo-1965-q2.summary: A homogeneous linear system $\sum_{j=1}^3a_{ij}x_j=0$ has positive diagonal coefficients, negative off-diagonal coefficients, and a positive sum of coefficients in every row. Prove that its only solution is $x_1=x_2=x_3=0$.
imo-1965-q2.summaryZh: 齐次线性方程组 $\sum_{j=1}^3a_{ij}x_j=0$ 的对角系数为正，非对角系数为负，且每一行系数之和为正。证明其唯一解为 $x_1=x_2=x_3=0$。
imo-1965-q2.answer: The zero vector is the unique solution.

methods.title: Apply strict diagonal dominance to the largest coordinate
methods.titleZh: 对绝对值最大的坐标使用严格对角占优
steps: The sign conditions and the positive row sum give $a_{ii}>-\sum_{j\ne i}a_{ij}=\sum_{j\ne i}|a_{ij}|$ for each row $i$.
Assume a nonzero solution exists and choose $k$ with $|x_k|=M=\max_i|x_i|>0$. From row $k$, $a_{kk}x_k=-\sum_{j\ne k}a_{kj}x_j$.

Taking absolute values gives $a_{kk}M\le\sum_{j\ne k}|a_{kj}|\,|x_j|\le M\sum_{j\ne k}|a_{kj}|<Ma_{kk}$, a contradiction. Thus every coordinate is zero, and the zero vector plainly satisfies the system.
stepsZh: 由系数符号及每行系数和为正，对每个 $i$ 都有 $a_{ii}>-\sum_{j\ne i}a_{ij}=\sum_{j\ne i}|a_{ij}|$。
反设存在非零解，选取 $k$ 使 $|x_k|=M=\max_i|x_i|>0$。第 $k$ 行给出 $a_{kk}x_k=-\sum_{j\ne k}a_{kj}x_j$。
取绝对值后得到 $a_{kk}M\le\sum_{j\ne k}|a_{kj}|\,|x_j|\le M\sum_{j\ne k}|a_{kj}|<Ma_{kk}$，矛盾。因此所有坐标均为零，而零向量显然满足原方程组。

imo-1965-q3.summary: In tetrahedron $ABCD$, the opposite edges $AB$ and $CD$ have lengths $a,b$, distance $d$, and angle $\omega$. A plane $\varepsilon$ parallel to both edges divides the tetrahedron; its distances from $AB$ and $CD$ are in the ratio $k$. Find the ratio of the two resulting volumes.
imo-1965-q3.summaryZh: 在四面体 $ABCD$ 中，异面棱 $AB,CD$ 的长度分别为 $a,b$，距离为 $d$，夹角为 $\omega$。平面 $\varepsilon$ 同时平行于这两条棱并截分四面体；它到 $AB$ 与 $CD$ 的距离之比为 $k$。求两部分的体积比。
imo-1965-q3.answer: The solid adjacent to $AB$ and the solid adjacent to $CD$ have volume ratio $k^2(k+3):(3k+1)$.
imo-1965-q3.answerZh: 靠近 $AB$ 的部分与靠近 $CD$ 的部分的体积比为 $k^2(k+3):(3k+1)$。

methods.title: Parameterise the parallel cross-section and decompose the solid
methods.titleZh: 参数化平行截面并分割几何体
steps: Let the distances of $\varepsilon$ from $AB$ and $CD$ be $h$ and $\ell$, so $h/\ell=k$. Put $t=h/(h+\ell)=k/(1+k)$. Let the plane meet $AC,BC,BD,AD$ at $E,F,G,H$, respectively. Linear variation of signed distance gives $AE/AC=BF/BC=BG/BD=AH/AD=t$.

Face similarity shows $EF\parallel GH\parallel AB$ and $FG\parallel EH\parallel CD$, so $EFGH$ is a parallelogram. Write $V=[ABCD]$. The part adjacent to $AB$ is the union of tetrahedron $ABFG$ and the pyramid with apex $A$ and base $EFGH$.

Since $\triangle BFG\sim\triangle BCD$ with scale $t$, $[ABFG]=t^2V$. A diagonal of $EFGH$ divides its pyramid into two equal tetrahedra. Each has volume $t^2(1-t)V$: its relevant base area has factor $t^2$ and its height has factor $1-t$. Thus $V_{AB}=t^2(3-2t)V$.
Consequently $V_{CD}=V-V_{AB}=(1-t)^2(1+2t)V$. Substitution of $t=k/(1+k)$ yields $V_{AB}/V_{CD}=k^2(k+3)/(3k+1)$. Notice that $a,b,d,\omega$ cancel because affine slicing alone determines the ratio.
stepsZh: 设 $\varepsilon$ 到 $AB,CD$ 的距离分别为 $h,\ell$，则 $h/\ell=k$。令 $t=h/(h+\ell)=k/(1+k)$。平面依次与 $AC,BC,BD,AD$ 交于 $E,F,G,H$。有向距离在线段上呈线性变化，因此 $AE/AC=BF/BC=BG/BD=AH/AD=t$。
由各侧面内的相似关系，$EF\parallel GH\parallel AB$ 且 $FG\parallel EH\parallel CD$，所以 $EFGH$ 是平行四边形。记原四面体体积为 $V$。靠近 $AB$ 的部分可分成四面体 $ABFG$ 和以 $A$ 为顶点、$EFGH$ 为底的棱锥。
因 $\triangle BFG\sim\triangle BCD$，相似比为 $t$，故 $[ABFG]=t^2V$。平行四边形的一条对角线把后一个棱锥分成两个等体积四面体；每个四面体的底面积缩放因子为 $t^2$，高的缩放因子为 $1-t$，故体积均为 $t^2(1-t)V$。于是 $V_{AB}=t^2(3-2t)V$。
另一部分为 $V_{CD}=V-V_{AB}=(1-t)^2(1+2t)V$。代入 $t=k/(1+k)$，得到 $V_{AB}/V_{CD}=k^2(k+3)/(3k+1)$。参数 $a,b,d,\omega$ 消去，是因为体积比例只由仿射截分位置决定。

imo-1965-q4.summary: Find all ordered quadruples of real numbers $(x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4)$ such that each number plus the product of the other three equals $2$.
imo-1965-q4.summaryZh: 求所有实数有序四元组 $(x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4)$，使任意一个数与其余三个数之积的和都等于 $2$。

methods.title: Subtract pairs of the four symmetric equations
methods.titleZh: 两两相减四个对称方程
steps: Write the numbers as $a,b,c,d$. If all are equal to $u$, then $u+u^3=2$, or $(u-1)(u^2+u+2)=0$. The quadratic factor is positive, so $u=1$.
Otherwise relabel so $a\ne b$. Subtracting $a+bcd=2$ and $b+acd=2$ gives $(a-b)(1-cd)=0$, hence $cd=1$ and then $a+b=2$.
Subtracting $c+abd=2$ and $d+abc=2$ gives $(c-d)(1-ab)=0$. If $ab=1$, then $a+b=2$ forces $a=b=1$, impossible; therefore $c=d$. Since $cd=1$, either $c=d=1$ or $c=d=-1$.

The first choice would give $ab=1$, again impossible. Thus $c=d=-1$, and $c+abd=2$ gives $ab=-3$. Together with $a+b=2$, Vieta's formulas give $\{a,b\}=\{3,-1\}$. Direct substitution verifies all listed quadruples.
stepsZh: 把四个数记为 $a,b,c,d$。若它们全等于 $u$，则 $u+u^3=2$，即 $(u-1)(u^2+u+2)=0$。二次因子恒正，故 $u=1$。
否则重新编号，使 $a\ne b$。将 $a+bcd=2$ 与 $b+acd=2$ 相减，得 $(a-b)(1-cd)=0$，从而 $cd=1$，并由原式得到 $a+b=2$。
将 $c+abd=2$ 与 $d+abc=2$ 相减，得 $(c-d)(1-ab)=0$。若 $ab=1$，结合 $a+b=2$ 会迫使 $a=b=1$，矛盾；所以 $c=d$。再由 $cd=1$，有 $c=d=1$ 或 $c=d=-1$。
第一种情形又会得到 $ab=1$，仍矛盾。因此 $c=d=-1$，代入 $c+abd=2$ 得 $ab=-3$。结合 $a+b=2$，由韦达定理知 $\{a,b\}=\{3,-1\}$。直接代入可验证所有列出的四元组。

imo-1965-q5.summary: Triangle $OAB$ has acute angle $AOB$. From a point $M\ne O$, drop perpendiculars to $OA,OB$ with feet $P,Q$. Let $H$ be the orthocentre of $\triangle OPQ$. Find the locus of $H$ when $M$ ranges over (a) segment $AB$, and (b) the interior of $\triangle OAB$.
imo-1965-q5.summaryZh: 三角形 $OAB$ 的角 $AOB$ 为锐角。由点 $M\ne O$ 分别向 $OA,OB$ 作垂线，垂足为 $P,Q$；令 $H$ 为 $\triangle OPQ$ 的垂心。求当 $M$ 遍历（a）线段 $AB$；（b）$\triangle OAB$ 内部时，$H$ 的轨迹。
imo-1965-q5.answer: Let $A'$ and $B'$ be the feet from $A$ to $OB$ and from $B$ to $OA$. The loci are (a) the closed segment $A'B'$ and (b) the open interior of $\triangle OA'B'$.
imo-1965-q5.answerZh: 设 $A'$ 为 $A$ 到 $OB$ 的垂足，$B'$ 为 $B$ 到 $OA$ 的垂足。轨迹分别为（a）闭线段 $A'B'$；（b）$\triangle OA'B'$ 的内部，不含边界。

methods.title: Express the orthocentre by affine coordinates
steps: Take $O$ as origin. Let unit vectors $\mathbf u,\mathbf v$ point along $OA,OB$, put $OA=a$, $OB=b$, and $c=\cos\angle AOB$; then $0<c<1$. If $A',B'$ are the stated perpendicular feet, their vectors are $\mathbf a'=ac\mathbf v$ and $\mathbf b'=bc\mathbf u$.
Write $\mathbf m=\lambda a\mathbf u+\mu b\mathbf v$. Orthogonal projection gives $\mathbf p=(\lambda a+\mu bc)\mathbf u$ and $\mathbf q=(\lambda ac+\mu b)\mathbf v$.

Set $\mathbf h=\lambda\mathbf a'+\mu\mathbf b'=\lambda ac\mathbf v+\mu bc\mathbf u$. Directly, $(\mathbf h-\mathbf p)\cdot\mathbf v=0$ and $(\mathbf h-\mathbf q)\cdot\mathbf u=0$. Thus $PH\perp OQ$ and $QH\perp OP$, so this point is the orthocentre of $OPQ$.

For $M$ on $AB$, $\lambda,\mu\ge0$ and $\lambda+\mu=1$, so $H=\lambda A'+\mu B'$ traces exactly the closed segment $A'B'$. For $M$ inside $OAB$, $\lambda>0$, $\mu>0$, and $\lambda+\mu<1$; the same formula gives precisely the points having positive barycentric coordinates with respect to $O,A',B'$, namely the open interior of $OA'B'$.
stepsZh: 以 $O$ 为原点，取沿 $OA,OB$ 方向的单位向量 $\mathbf u,\mathbf v$，令 $OA=a$、$OB=b$、$c=\cos\angle AOB$，则 $0<c<1$。设 $A',B'$ 为题述垂足，其位置向量分别是 $\mathbf a'=ac\mathbf v$ 与 $\mathbf b'=bc\mathbf u$。
写成 $\mathbf m=\lambda a\mathbf u+\mu b\mathbf v$。正交投影给出 $\mathbf p=(\lambda a+\mu bc)\mathbf u$、$\mathbf q=(\lambda ac+\mu b)\mathbf v$。

令 $\mathbf h=\lambda\mathbf a'+\mu\mathbf b'=\lambda ac\mathbf v+\mu bc\mathbf u$。直接计算得 $(\mathbf h-\mathbf p)\cdot\mathbf v=0$ 且 $(\mathbf h-\mathbf q)\cdot\mathbf u=0$。因此 $PH\perp OQ$、$QH\perp OP$，该点正是 $OPQ$ 的垂心。

当 $M$ 在线段 $AB$ 上时，$\lambda,\mu\ge0$ 且 $\lambda+\mu=1$，所以 $H=\lambda A'+\mu B'$ 恰好遍历闭线段 $A'B'$。当 $M$ 在 $OAB$ 内部时，$\lambda>0$、$\mu>0$、$\lambda+\mu<1$；同一公式给出相对于 $O,A',B'$ 三点的三个重心坐标均为正，故轨迹恰为三角形 $OA'B'$ 的开内部。

imo-1965-q6.summary: Among $n\ge3$ distinct points in the plane, call a pair a diameter when its distance equals the largest distance $d$ occurring in the set. Prove that there are at most $n$ diameters.
imo-1965-q6.summaryZh: 平面内给定 $n\ge3$ 个不同点。若一对点的距离等于点集中出现的最大距离 $d$，就称其连线为一条直径。证明直径条数至多为 $n$。
imo-1965-q6.answer: The number of diameter pairs is at most $n$; a regular $n$-gon for odd $n$ shows that equality can occur.
imo-1965-q6.answerZh: 直径点对至多有 $n$ 对；当 $n$ 为奇数时，正 $n$ 边形说明等号可以达到。

methods.title: Find a degree-one endpoint and induct on the diameter graph
methods.titleZh: 在直径图中寻找度为一的端点并归纳
steps: Scale so $d=1$ and form the graph whose edges join pairs at distance $1$. We first prove a lemma: if a vertex $O$ has at least three diameter neighbours, then one of those neighbours has degree exactly one.

Take $O$ as origin and fix one unit neighbour $U$. Every unit neighbour $X$ of $O$ also satisfies $|X-U|\le1$, so $X\cdot U=(2-|X-U|^2)/2\ge1/2$. Hence all neighbours of $O$ lie on one $120^\circ$ arc of the unit circle. Choose three in angular order, $A,B,C$. The ray $OB$ meets the interior of chord $AC$, so $B=\lambda A+\mu C$ for some $\lambda,\mu>0$. Since the three are distinct unit vectors, $1=|B|^2=(\lambda+\mu)^2-\lambda\mu|A-C|^2$, hence $\lambda+\mu>1$.

For any other point $Q\ne O$, the diameter bound gives $|Q-A|,|Q-C|\le1$, hence $2Q\cdot A\ge|Q|^2$ and $2Q\cdot C\ge|Q|^2$. Therefore $|Q-B|^2=|Q|^2+1-2Q\cdot B\le1-(\lambda+\mu-1)|Q|^2<1$. Thus $B$ is joined by a diameter only to $O$, proving the lemma.

Induct on $n$. If every vertex has degree at most two, the handshake lemma gives $2E\le2n$, so $E\le n$. Otherwise apply the lemma and delete its degree-one vertex $B$. At least two diameter neighbours of $O$ remain, so the maximum distance of the remaining set is still $1$. By induction it has at most $n-1$ diameter edges; restoring $B$ adds exactly one, giving at most $n$.
stepsZh: 缩放使 $d=1$，并建立直径图：距离为 $1$ 的点对相连。先证引理：若顶点 $O$ 至少有三个直径邻点，则这些邻点中有一个点的度恰为一。

以 $O$ 为原点，固定一个单位邻点 $U$。$O$ 的任一单位邻点 $X$ 还满足 $|X-U|\le1$，所以 $X\cdot U=(2-|X-U|^2)/2\ge1/2$。故 $O$ 的所有邻点都落在单位圆的一段 $120^\circ$ 圆弧上。按角度顺序取三个点 $A,B,C$，射线 $OB$ 穿过弦 $AC$ 的内部，因此 $B=\lambda A+\mu C$，其中 $\lambda,\mu>0$。三点是不同的单位向量，故 $1=|B|^2=(\lambda+\mu)^2-\lambda\mu|A-C|^2$，从而 $\lambda+\mu>1$。
对任意另一点 $Q\ne O$，最大距离条件给出 $|Q-A|,|Q-C|\le1$，所以 $2Q\cdot A\ge|Q|^2$ 且 $2Q\cdot C\ge|Q|^2$。于是 $|Q-B|^2=|Q|^2+1-2Q\cdot B\le1-(\lambda+\mu-1)|Q|^2<1$。因此 $B$ 只与 $O$ 构成直径，引理得证。
对 $n$ 归纳。若每个顶点的度至多为二，由握手定理 $2E\le2n$，故 $E\le n$。否则使用引理，删去度为一的点 $B$。$O$ 至少还保留两个直径邻点，所以剩余点集的最大距离仍为 $1$。由归纳假设，剩余图至多有 $n-1$ 条直径边；恢复 $B$ 只增加边 $OB$，总数至多为 $n$。
